title: Sentry Organization auth token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 42-character secret vs the 43 characters 32 base64-encoded bytes produce. Twin of "Sentry Organization auth token: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of sentry-org-auth-token-actions-env: length: 42-character secret vs the 43 characters 32 base64-encoded bytes produce. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
